environment: Windows 11 Home (10.0.26200), 32 logical cores. In-app Chromium browser pane: ANGLE / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (D3D11). Headless Google Chrome 152.0.7977.83 with SwiftShader (software WebGL). Local static server (python http.server). Measured 2026-09-13.

tests.name: Geometry + program audit (tools/hero3d/audit.mjs)
tests.result: all scripted checks pass (see section 1); runtime < 1 s

tests.name: Desktop hero, real GPU (in-app browser)
tests.settings: 1350 × 910 CSS px, DPR 1, canvas 1335 × 818, shadows on, S = 0.92
tests.result: 102 draw calls per frame; median 5.0 ms, p95 5.1 ms per frame during pointer parallax (display-refresh limited); 0 draw calls over 2 s idle (render-on-demand pause holds); JS heap ≈ 50 MB; no console errors

tests.name: Mobile tier, emulated in the in-app browser
tests.settings: 375 × 812 CSS px emulation (device DPR 2, tier cap 1.25 → canvas 468 × 905), shadows off, settled wireframes dropped
tests.result: 72 draw calls per frame; median 5.0 ms, p95 5.2 ms during drag rotation — on the desktop GPU, so NOT representative of a phone; 0 idle draws; no horizontal overflow

tests.name: Animation states (headless)
tests.result: grid → footprints → rising wireframes (towers rise as one stack per tower) → dithered materialise → landscape/pools/fountain → final composition → handoff; no missing or floating elements observed

tests.name: Live intro (headless, no frozen S)
tests.result: intro drawing starts; hero initialises without errors

tests.name: Reduced motion (headless)
tests.result: static final composition rendered; no scroll-driven animation; water clock frozen

tests.name: Mobile hero framing (headless)
tests.settings: 500 × 1084 CSS px (headless minimum width), mobile tier
tests.result: model, resort pool and fountain visible below the hero text; no overlap with copy

tests.name: Hero-camera visibility (ray-marched, audit)
tests.settings: desktop key frame S 0.92; mobile camera travel 0.55

tests.name: QA overlay
tests.result: columns, cores, transfer rings, stalls, aisles, ramp, lifts, basin and hotel BOH rooms render over the model

notPerformed: No physical phone or tablet was tested. Mobile results above come from desktop emulation and headless Chrome and are not device validation.
No low-end or integrated GPU was tested; SwiftShader renders confirm correctness only, not performance.
No Safari / iOS WebKit or Firefox testing.
No thermal, battery or long-session memory testing.
No accessibility audit of the page beyond reduced-motion behaviour.
Frame times are display-refresh limited on the test machine; GPU frame cost under load was not profiled.
